Synopsis:
Default dialogue with Helsik. They are a trader and warlock in lower city. They grant us the ingredients to perform the ritual to the House of Hope. 

HELPFUL DEBUG COMMANDS:
oe LOW_GetItemsFromGortash - learn about Helsik from Gortash's note
oe LOW_KnowAllHelsik - learn that Helsik is a diabolist and that they know the way to the HoH
oe LOW_PortalHouseOfHope - set up the interactable HoH portal without having to do the ritual

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_DevilsFee_Helsik.json: Helsik is a lower‑city trader and warlock/diabolist who knows the ritual route into the House of Hope and can supply the ingredients you need for it. They openly demand a large “devil’s fee” — money or tribute owed to Lord Mammon — for helping you attempt what they regard as effectively a suicide mission. You can bargain (for example, offering one of Raphael’s artifacts) to try to waive the fee, which puts Helsik in a conflicted, transactional position. Companions may protest the plan as reckless, and nearby events mentioned in some contexts (a disturbed windmill, a trapped pixie in a moonlantern, or goblins drawn off‑screen) might be happening simultaneously but are separate from this deal.

- LOW_DevilsFee_RitualCircle.json: Dialog to invoke the ritual to go to House of Hope from Lower City.RELEVANT NOTE: This dialog will only appear at the first time players go to house of hope. Later, this never will be triggered again.
- LOW_SorcerousSundries_Rolan.json: Dialog with Sorcerous Sundries' clerk Rolan. He will explain how Lorroakan is neglecting him in his search for the Nightsong. Player can ask Rolan to make a portal to Lorroakan.
- MOO_InfernalVendor.json: A merchant selling in the bazaar on the ground floor of Moonrise Tower. She is very interested in illithid-tainted blood from each race, which when traded grants a different kind of potion as a reward. The player can also learn her house's origins - and the fact that she's here to research the illithids.For nodes marked as OOM AND COM are in their own dialog fileFor nodes not marked as OOM or COM the dialog will have these speakers:1. context: Helsik is a lower‑city trader and warlock/diabolist who knows the ritual route into the House of Hope and can supply the ingredients you need to attempt it. They treat the venture as effectively suicidal and openly demand a large “devil’s fee” — money or tribute for Lord Mammon — in exchange for help. You can bargain (for example by offering one of Raphael’s artifacts) to try to waive the fee, which puts Helsik in a conflicted, transactional position and may draw protests from companions. This exchange covers the initial arrangement to perform the ritual; the ritual dialog that opens the portal to the House of Hope only appears the first time you attempt it. Nearby, unrelated lower‑city events (disturbed windmill, trapped pixie, goblins) might be occurring off‑screen but do not affect this deal.
